(2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit, modern bathroom or dressing area. The woman stands before a large mirror, holding a white cloth and carefully dabbing the skin around her eyes. She points towards her lower eyelids, highlighting the area she intends to treat while speaking clearly and smiling. (3) The camera captures a close-up of a medical aesthetic procedure. A patient lies horizontally with protective black goggles covering their eyes. A gloved hand operates a white medical handpiece with a blue logo, which emits flashes of light as it moves across the patient's cheek and temple area. (4) Returning to the mirrored room, the woman wraps a white headband around her hair. She smiles confidently, gesturing with her hands to emphasize her points about the treatment's comfort and effectiveness while looking at her reflection. In the background, a large digital monitor displays clinical parameters, surrounded by professional medical lighting equipment. (6) The speaker concludes her narrative in the mirrored dressing room, looking refreshed and touching her face to demonstrate skin tightness. The video ends with a branded static screen displaying the clinic logo, phone number, and physical addresses in Traditional Chinese text.
